answer: Like crystallization purifying minerals, decentralized consensus weeds out impostors on an unyielding ledge. Each node validates identity through an interconnected web of mutual staking vouchers. Attacking this structure demands superlinear capital costs: spawning clone swarms scales staking collateral quadratically, turning each artificial identity into a financial chasm. Even if a raven or sable beast stalks the boundary, coordinated fabrication collapses under ruinous staking thresholds.
